security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; media-src 'self' blob:; connect-src 'none'; font-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'

bundle.longDescription: Nukamiso is a zero-dependency, local-first subtitle editor. Dictate subtitles with your voice, edit them, and export SRT/VTT/ASS/TXT. Your data never leaves the device.
